title: Plastic piping.
officialText:
Plastic piping used for venting appliances listed for use with such venting materials shall be listed and
installed in accordance with the terms of its listing and the manufacturers’ instructions. Installation shall be in accordance with the
New York City Building Code. PVC shall not be permitted.
